facts.material: reinforced marine-grade PVC, closed-cell foam, laminated LDPE bubble material
facts.function: floating platform on which a vessel rests so its hull is out of the water to reduce marine growth
facts.form: fully assembled floating structure in five sizes, moored to a berth; not attached to or part of a vessel, not a dock

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8907 other floating structures (rafts, tanks, landing-stages, buoys); chapter 89 note and Section XVII do not exclude

rejected_alternatives.reason: floating docks; importer states it does not function as a dock or fixed marine structure
inflatable rafts; this is a moored hull-support structure with foam, not a raft
buoys; not a buoy or beacon
yachts and vessels; it is not a vessel
articles of plastics; heading 8907 covers floating structures more specifically

classification.rationale: A moored floating platform that is not a vessel or dock is an other floating structure of heading 8907. I87186 placed a modular plastic floating system in 8907.90.0090 (other floating structures, other); the goods fit the residual line.
